name: BDP building history for the last three days

parameters.content:
## Last three days of building history

Run manually to read historical values for one building, from three days before execution until now. Results are native records, one n8n item per value, and all pages are requested. BDP determines whether the time boundaries are inclusive.

## Before running

Open **Read Building History**:
1. Select your BDP Community OAuth2 API credential and environment.
2. Select Resource = Building and Operation = Historical Values.
3. Select a building from the list, or switch to By ID and enter its ID. Optionally narrow Building Search Scope to an organization or site.
4. Keep Start = `{{ $now.minus({ days: 3 }).toUTC().toISO() }}`, End = `{{ $now.toUTC().toISO() }}`, and Return All = on.

The time expressions are already configured. Runs are not snapshots or exactly-once reads.
